people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”
translations.bsb: When Ahab saw Elijah, he said to him, “Is that you, O troubler of Israel?”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Is it thou, thou troubler of Israel?
